messages:
ops-oncall: Heads up — we had svc-x pages that didn't actually notify the primary oncall. They only showed up after I manually escalated from the monitoring page at ~2265432250. Anyone else see delayed deliveries?

sanjay: saw one alert pop into the channel late too. PD shows trigger at 2265432205 but the page timestamp for the oncall was 2265432248. ~43s delay, then nothing until manual escalate.

maria: oncall routing logs show incident-bot accepted the webhook but then applied a channel filter and marked as suppressed for the channel group `eng-*`. looks suspicious. grabbing logs now.

incident-bot: automated log: received webhook id=evt_0a1b2c from monitoring; routing_policy=primary; channel_match=eng-.*; filter_result=exclude; action=suppressed (reason=channel_filter_regex_match)

alex: who changed the `channel_filter_regex` for incident-bot? I thought we only had that to avoid pages into archived channels.

maria: config show: `channel_filter_regex: ^(?:eng-(?:infra|sre|oncall)|product)$` — that was deployed in the last rollout. It looks like `eng-oncall` is included but some dedicated oncall channels are named `eng-oncall-<team>` (e.g., `eng-oncall-svcx`) so they didn't match and got excluded.

ops-oncall: that explains it — our svc-x oncall is `eng-oncall-svcx`. PD triggered but incident-bot suppressed because it didn't match the allowed pattern.

sanjay: timeline: 2265432205 alert triggered; incident-bot received and suppressed immediately; ops-oncall manually escalated at 2265432248; pagerduty-bot then created an unresolved incident at 2265432250 when manual escalate happened. Customer reported degraded 2265432275 via support ticket.

lisa: customer impact: a subset of tenants experienced elevated latency in inference pipeline for ~2m starting 2265432198; alerting was correct but routing gap = increased MTTR. Support reached out.

alex: immediate mitigation: disable the channel_filter_regex by setting it to empty and restart incident-bot, so we fallback to PD routing only. Can someone confirm command?

maria: running:```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/incident-bot CHANNEL_FILTER_REGEX=""
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/incident-bot
```

incident-bot: system: acknowledged rollout command; starting graceful shutdown; new config loaded at 2265432320; incoming webhooks will not be filtered by channel regex.

pagerduty-bot: PD: created incident #PD-7891 (manual escalation). automatic resend attempted for suppressed events failed earlier.

ops-oncall: after restart we validated with a synthetic alert: sent test webhook at 2265432335 -> oncall received at 2265432336. :thumbsup:

sanjay: can we add a fallback that if an event is flagged suppressed by channel filter, we still send a PD page to primary oncall? today it treats suppressed as final.

maria: agreed — short-term patch: change suppression behavior to log+forward to PD default escalation. I'll open an urgent PR and push to staging.

alex: PR linked here: https://github.com/redwood/incident-bot/pull/412 — patch will change action=suppressed -> action=forward_to_pd when filter_result=exclude and severity >= critical.

maria: quick verification notes:
- search logs: `kubectl logs deployment/incident-bot | rg "filter_result=exclude" | tail -n 20`
- confirm env now blank: `kubectl get deploy incident-bot -o yaml | yq .spec.template.spec.containers[0].env`
- synthetic test: `curl -X POST https://hooks.internal/incident -d '{"service":"svc-x","severity":"critical"}'`

ops-oncall: added manual ticket to oncall handoff: we owe SRE handover notes for the night team — marking as P1 until postmortem.

lisa: customer impact summary for ops: customer_a affected 2265432198-2265432400, increased 95th latency to 1.9s, no data loss. Support already emailed impacted accounts.

sanjay: retrospective action items (short list):
- revert channel naming or update regex to include `eng-oncall-.*` (maria)
- implement fallback forward_to_pd for suppressed events (maria)
- add integration tests for channel patterns (alex)
- run a drill to validate pages for all oncall channels weekly (ops-oncall)
- postmortem and SLA impact note (lisa)

maria: creating the postmortem draft now: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/2265432199-incidentbot-channelregression.md — will include timeline, config diff, and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: system: archived suppressed event ids: [evt_0a1b2c] -> note: reforward attempted: false (pre-fix)

ops-oncall: closing the live thread — monitoring shows normal. keeping P1 marker for postmortem until written. thanks everyone. :heart:

alex: followup: can we add a canary rule that flags when incident-bot suppresses > 1 critical event in 5m? prefer alert to eng-sre channel. I'll propose in the PR.
